narration: First, the system takes three visual inputs: reference motion frames, a reference identity frame, and a noisy target frame.
These visual frames are concatenated together to form a fused spatial conditioning representation.
Simultaneously, the driving audio waveform is encoded by an audio encoder into acoustic speech features.
The central diffusion model receives the combined visual features, the audio features, and the diffusion time encoding.
Finally, the diffusion network generates the denoised target frame synchronized with the speech.
